# ARWP Agent Skills

Use these portable skills when an AI coding agent should improve, prepare or maintain a website under ARWP.

## Default growth workflow
- arwp-growth-loop — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-growth-loop/SKILL.md

Use it for Search growth, Google Discover/recommendations, generative Search, AI citations, current platform adaptation and ongoing evidence-backed website improvement.

## Search release gate
- arwp-search-release — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-search-release/SKILL.md

Use it before calling a public hostname search-ready. It checks the Search result as a product surface: hostname scope, site identity, title sources, visible snippet candidates, favicon delivery, canonical host, sitemap/robots, internal discovery, localization, GitHub Pages domain behavior, final generated output and the later owner-observed Search result. A green repository check is not engine-selection or ranking evidence.

## Reference benchmarking
- arwp-search-maturity — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-search-maturity/SKILL.md

Use it to compare a target site with timestamped independent Search/AI reference cohorts. Repeated features remain observational evidence unless stronger evidence exists; numeric rank requires explicit rank evidence.

## Initial preparation and focus
- arwp-prepare-site — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-prepare-site/SKILL.md
- arwp-site-focus — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-site-focus/SKILL.md

## Measurement
- arwp-measurement-os — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-measurement-os/SKILL.md

Keep readiness, crawl/index state, Search presentation, impressions/clicks, AI citations/referrals and business outcomes as separate evidence stages.

## Multi-site portfolio operations
- arwp-portfolio-fleet — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-portfolio-fleet/SKILL.md

Use it to inspect local Git/profile state across many checkouts, run reviewed checks without a shell, and perform bounded live-profile verification before selecting one site for implementation.

## Adaptive implementation
- arwp-adaptive-upgrade — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-adaptive-upgrade/SKILL.md
- arwp-target-transformation — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-target-transformation/SKILL.md

## Evidence-to-change provenance
- arwp-braidgraph — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-braidgraph/SKILL.md

Use it to explain why a repository change exists, trace source/rule lineage, preserve superseded history, compute re-review blast radius and separate missing implementation verification from missing Search/AI outcome evidence.

## Specialists
- arwp-discoverability — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-discoverability/SKILL.md
- arwp-ai-search-content — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-ai-search-content/SKILL.md
- arwp-future-search — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-future-search/SKILL.md
- arwp-dataset-publication — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-dataset-publication/SKILL.md
- arwp-agent-discovery — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-agent-discovery/SKILL.md
- arwp-evidence-ci — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-evidence-ci/SKILL.md

Use arwp-future-search after current crawl/index/canonical/content/identity foundations are healthy. It may implement truthful broader Schema.org semantics and experimental machine graphs even when they are not current ranking requirements, but each mechanism keeps explicit maturity and verification.

## Install
npx skills add dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile

## Rule
Research -> classify current vs observational vs experimental -> establish site focus -> fix technical eligibility -> run Search Release -> benchmark when useful -> implement -> trace provenance/impact when needed -> verify final production -> measure owner-observed outcomes. Do not claim that ARWP, BraidGraph adjacency, a reference-cohort pattern, semantic-index JSON-LD, llms.txt, Schema.org volume, Agent Skills or another metadata mechanism guarantees ranking, Discover placement, AI citation, recommendations or traffic.
